author: Yamatzu
body:
Hello, Avicus I'm just suggesting something I think would be useful so people have less lag!

My suggestion is Avicus makes servers worldwide like so people in different countries can connect easier Ex:
eu.avic.us would connect you to the EU servers?
or au.avicus.us

You know! I think this would be really helpful!
